description: Defines the subscription settings UI for the Notesnook web application, including subscription management, plan changes, payment updates, trial cancellation, refunds, and billing history.

methods.name: toggle
methods.description: Toggles the auto-renew subscription status between paused and active, updating the database and user store accordingly.

methods.name: action (Change plan button)
methods.description: Opens the change plan dialog for the user to modify their subscription plan.

methods.name: action (Update payment method button)
methods.description: Fetches the update URL for the subscription and opens it in a new tab for the user to update their payment details.

methods.name: action (Cancel trial button)
methods.description: Confirms and cancels the user's trial, updating the subscription status.

methods.name: action (Refund subscription button)
methods.description: Handles refund requests, including confirmation, processing, and user notifications.
